title: Paper Chromatography
learningGoal: Prepare, spot, develop, mark, measure, and calculate Rf values from a paper chromatogram.

actions.label: Calculate Rf values

parameters.interpretationLimit: Rf is conditional on this solvent system and these conditions; a matching Rf does not prove identity.

interaction.accessibleLabel: For each band, divide the distance the band travelled by the distance the solvent front travelled.
interaction.successCue: Rf values are calculated from the recorded distances.
interaction.invalidCue: Read and record the solvent front and every band distance before calculating Rf.

stateChanges: Calculate Rf values: Rf values are calculated from the measured distances.

nodes.title: Place chamber
nodes.description: Place the empty chamber upright on the workbench.

feedback.success: Place chamber complete.
feedback.retry: Review Place chamber and try again.

nodes.title: Add solvent
nodes.description: Pour a shallow solvent layer into the chamber below the future baseline.

feedback.success: Add solvent complete.
feedback.retry: Review Add solvent and try again.

nodes.title: Lay paper flat
nodes.description: Place the chromatography paper flat before marking.

feedback.success: Lay paper flat complete.
feedback.retry: Review Lay paper flat and try again.

nodes.title: Draw baseline
nodes.description: Use the pencil to draw a light baseline near the bottom edge.

feedback.success: Draw baseline complete.
feedback.retry: Review Draw baseline and try again.

nodes.title: Load capillary
nodes.description: Touch the capillary tip to the dye sample.

feedback.success: Load capillary complete.
feedback.retry: Review Load capillary and try again.

nodes.title: Spot sample
nodes.description: Touch the loaded capillary to the baseline.

feedback.success: Spot sample complete.
feedback.retry: Review Spot sample and try again.

nodes.title: Dry spot
nodes.description: Observe the spot until it dries before development.

feedback.success: Dry spot complete.

nodes.description: Place the paper in the chamber with the solvent below the spot and the lid closed.

feedback.success: Develop paper complete.

nodes.title: Remove paper

nodes.title: Mark solvent front

nodes.title: Place ruler

commonMistakes.when: baseline is marked with soluble ink
commonMistakes.message: Use pencil for the baseline so the line does not dissolve.
commonMistakes.recovery: Mark the baseline with pencil before spotting.

commonMistakes.when: spot is below the solvent surface
commonMistakes.message: The sample spot must stay above the solvent.
commonMistakes.recovery: Use a shallow solvent layer and suspend the paper carefully.

commonMistakes.when: the paper dries before the solvent front is marked
commonMistakes.message: An unmarked front leaves every Rf without a denominator.
commonMistakes.recovery: Mark the front as the strip leaves the chamber; otherwise repeat the trial.

commonMistakes.when: distances are read before the marked paper dries
commonMistakes.message: Wet bands keep migrating, so the reading is not the band centre.
commonMistakes.recovery: Dry the marked strip flat, then align the ruler on the origin.
